settings.title: What weight is the cotton
settings.body: 8.2 oz on the tees and tanks, 12 oz twill on the cargo and shorts, 14 oz fleece on the crews.

settings.title: How does it fit
settings.body: Boxy through the body with a set shoulder. True to size for a relaxed fit; size down for a closer one.

settings.title: Will it shrink
settings.body: No. It is garment-dyed and washed twice before it is cut, so the shrink happens before you own it.

settings.title: How do I wash it
settings.body: Cold, inside out, like colours. Tumble low or hang. No softener — it coats heavyweight cotton and stops it breathing.

settings.title: When will my order ship
settings.body: Before 2pm Eastern on a business day, it is picked the same day. Otherwise the next.

settings.title: Do you ship internationally
settings.body: Canada today, with duties payable on delivery. The rest of the world through our international rate.

settings.title: What is the returns window
settings.body: Thirty days from delivery, unworn with tags on. Shipping is covered both ways within the US.

settings.title: Something arrived faulty
settings.body: Email hello@wearryvt.com with your order number and a photograph. We replace or refund, your choice.

settings.title: Do you restock
settings.body: Yes. Small runs are restocked rather than replaced, so a sold-out style comes back.

settings.title: Where are you based
settings.body: Metro Detroit, Michigan. Cut and finished here.

settings.heading: Questions
settings.lede: The eleven we are asked most. Anything else, email hello@wearryvt.com.
